name: Arista Networks
tagline: Cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments
hero_kpi_rationale: Le chiffre d'affaires Produit (switches et routeurs haute performance pour datacenters cloud et IA) est le coeur du modele d'Arista, distinct du chiffre d'affaires Service (support et SaaS CloudVision). Serie annuelle propre 2020 a 2025 (1.83 a 7.58 Mds $), jamais egale au chiffre d'affaires total (9.01 Mds $ en 2025).

kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires net des produits Arista (switches et routeurs Ethernet haute performance pour datacenters cloud et IA, systemes 400G et 800G). Coeur du modele, distinct du chiffre d'affaires Service.

kpis.explanation_en: Net product revenue (high-performance Ethernet switches and routers for cloud and AI data centers, 400G and 800G systems). Core of the model, distinct from Service revenue.

company_description: Arista Networks is a supplier of cloud networking solutions that use software innovations to address the needs of large-scale data center, campus and routing environments. Arista delivers high-performance Ethernet switching and routing platforms (including 400G and 800G systems) running a single, extensible operating system, Arista EOS, complemented by the CloudVision network management and automation suite. A large share of revenue comes from a concentrated set of cloud and AI hyperscalers (Cloud and AI Titans such as Microsoft and Meta). The company splits its revenue between Product (switching and routing hardware) and Service (post-contract support and software subscriptions), across three geographic regions: Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific.
_validation: EXTRACTION verbatim 10-K ANET (ANET_2026-02-17 FY2025 + ANET_2024-02-13 + ANET_2023-02-14 + ANET_2022-02-15). Aucun chiffre invente.

Service Revenue : disaggregation Product vs Service, 6 ans 2020-2025.
Americas / EMEA / Asia Pacific : information geographique des 10-K, 5 ans 2021-2025.
Product Gross Margin : derive des montants verbatim Product Revenue et Cost of Products (3 ans 2023-2025), tague is_short_history.
CONTROLE contamination : aucun KPI egal au chiffre d'affaires total consolide (9.01 Mds $ en 2025). Hero = Product Revenue (7.58 Mds $) different du total. Aucune duplication d'historique.
